metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than northern Ethiopia relative its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use CHIRPS daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) – global, 0.05°, 1981-present. - Date windows: • Short-term: 01 Oct → 30 Nov 2021 (2 months). • Long-term climatology: same calendar window for every year 2000-2013 (14 years), i.e. doy 275–334. - Regions: • Southern Ethiopia ≈ polys below 7°N (kebele-level public AOI used in literature, ~350 000 km²). • Northern Ethiopia ≈ polys above 12°N (Tigray & Amhara highlands, ~280 000 km²). - Scale: 5000 m (CHIRPS native 5 km) to stay fast; sum rainfall and then average per region. 2. Masking: None needed (precip, not clouds). 3. Logic: Compute mean total Oct-Nov rainfall 2000-2013 per region (clim). Compute total Oct-Nov 2021 per region (act). Relative anomaly = (act – clim)/clim. If south anomaly < north anomaly → “less relative to its own average” → A; else B. Handle: - Collection empty → C1 - After summing, any region has 0 valid pixels → C2 - Any clim or act result is None/NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry south = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB/2017").filter(ee.Filter.And( ee.Filter.eq("COUNTRY_NA","Ethiopia"), ee.Filter.lt("LAT",7))) # approx southern half north = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB/2017").filter(ee.Filter.And( ee.Filter.eq("COUNTRY_NA","Ethiopia"), ee.Filter.gt("LAT",12))) # approx northern half geom_s = south.geometry() geom_n = north.geometry() # 2. Data def oct_nov_sum(y): start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y,10,1) end = start.advance(2,'month') return (ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY") .filterDate(start,end) .sum() .rename('precip')) clim_col = ee.ImageCollection(ee.List.sequence(2000,2013).map(oct_nov_sum)) act_2021 = oct_nov_sum(2021) # 3. Helpers def regional_mean(img,geom): return img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom,scale=5000,maxPixels=1e9).get('precip') # 4. Checks if clim_col.size().getInfo()==0: print("No climatology images.") print("C1") exit() # 5. Calculation clim_s = ee.ImageCollection(clim_col.map(lambda i: regional_mean(i,geom_s))).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()) clim_n = ee.ImageCollection(clim_col.map(lambda i: regional_mean(i,geom_n))).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()) act_s = regional_mean(act_2021,geom_s) act_n = regional_mean(act_2021,geom_n) val_s = ee.Number(act_s).subtract(clim_s).divide(clim_s).getInfo() val_n = ee.Number(act_n).subtract(clim_n).divide(clim_n).getInfo() print(f"South anomaly: {val_s:.3f}, North anomaly: {val_n:.3f}") if val_s is None or val_n is None: print("C3") else: print("A" if val_s < val_n else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry
south = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB/2017").filter(ee.Filter.And(
        ee.Filter.eq("COUNTRY_NA","Ethiopia"),
        ee.Filter.lt("LAT",7)))         # approx southern half
north = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB/2017").filter(ee.Filter.And(
        ee.Filter.eq("COUNTRY_NA","Ethiopia"),
        ee.Filter.gt("LAT",12)))        # approx northern half
geom_s = south.geometry()
geom_n = north.geometry()

# 2. Data
def oct_nov_sum(y):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y,10,1)
    end   = start.advance(2,'month')
    return (ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY")
              .filterDate(start,end)
              .sum()
              .rename('precip'))

clim_col = ee.ImageCollection(ee.List.sequence(2000,2013).map(oct_nov_sum))
act_2021 = oct_nov_sum(2021)

# 3. Helpers
def regional_mean(img,geom):
    return img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=geom,scale=5000,maxPixels=1e9).get('precip')

# 4. Checks
if clim_col.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("No climatology images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 5. Calculation
clim_s = ee.ImageCollection(clim_col.map(lambda i: regional_mean(i,geom_s))).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean())
clim_n = ee.ImageCollection(clim_col.map(lambda i: regional_mean(i,geom_n))).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean())
act_s  = regional_mean(act_2021,geom_s)
act_n  = regional_mean(act_2021,geom_n)

val_s = ee.Number(act_s).subtract(clim_s).divide(clim_s).getInfo()
val_n = ee.Number(act_n).subtract(clim_n).divide(clim_n).getInfo()

print(f"South anomaly: {val_s:.3f}, North anomaly: {val_n:.3f}")

if val_s is None or val_n is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if val_s < val_n else "<answer>B</answer>")
